implementation_notes: Exported `const`/functions from a shared module, `as const` objects for constant tables, and `satisfies` to type them against a contract without widening. Types are the deduplicated knowledge: one exported interface replaces repeated inline object shapes.
idiom_name: exported const + as const + satisfies + shared types
pitfalls: Duplicated inline object literal types instead of one exported type
Enums (unless const) becoming runtime objects rather than types
